verdict.rationale: The README documents installing a single named skill with `npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills --skill wiki-yylo`, plus an interactive install flow, and the skills are described as independently versioned. That clearly supports picking specific skills rather than the whole collection. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that selective install works; selective install is shown only via the generic `skills` CLI, while the plugin route ships all eight skills together and `yy skills install` updates all copies.
